Bethlehem Die Cutting

Bethlehem Die Cutting is a division of Kyana Packaging & Industrial Supply and performs die cutting of non-ferrous products, such as corrugated trays, pads, and partitions. They are modernizing operations and investing in automating the die cutting process to build additional capacity and the new Kongsberg CAD/CAM sample table will compress the turnaround time for design and testing of samples of new products.
